title: Joel And Kerri — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage farm love
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Joel and Kerri built their life on red Zimbabwe clay
They planted every seed by hand and watched the seasons play
Two countries in their hearts but one beneath their feet
The farm was never easy but the farm was never beat

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Joel naKerri vakaita imba pamusoro penyika
[Joel and Kerri made a home on top of the land]
Vakadyara mbeu, vakamirira mvura yekudenga
[They planted seeds, they waited for rain from the sky]
Mwoyo miviri, nyika imwe — vanozviziva
[Two hearts, one land — they know this]
Kushanda nesimba, kutevera tariro
[Working with strength, following hope]

[Chorus — English]
Joel and Kerri, hand in hand
Standing on the red dust of their land
Joel and Kerri, year by year
Love that grows like crops when rain is near

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
UJoel noKerri, bakhele eZimbabwe
[Joel and Kerri, they settled in Zimbabwe]
Bathanda umhlabathi, bathanda ukukhula
[They love the soil, they love to grow]
Izinyanga ezidlulile zikhuluma ngothando
[The passing seasons speak of love]
Izandla zabo zisebenza, izinhliziyo zabo zihlangene
[Their hands work, their hearts are joined]

[Outro — All three languages]
Joel and Kerri… Joel naKerri… UJoel noKerri
Two hearts, one farm — Mwoyo miviri, shamba rimwe — Izinhliziyo ezimbili, ipulazi elilodwa
The gardens still growing
